title: landlord_charged_me_for_grass
display_title: My Landlord Fined Me $75 for 'Unauthorized Landscaping' — So I Followed His Lease to the Letter
beats: My landlord charged me $75 for 'unauthorized landscaping' because I pulled three dandelions from the yard.
The lease said tenants 'may not alter existing vegetation without written approval' — so fine, I stopped touching anything, including the grass.
By week six, that grass was two feet tall and the HOA he answers to sent him a violation notice with a $200 fine attached.
He texted me demanding I mow it immediately, and I reminded him: altering vegetation requires his written approval, and he never gave it.
He paid the $200, I kept my $75, and he emailed me 'approval' to mow within the hour. Was I wrong?
